text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 102, November 04, 1947 ]
ORDERING THE SUSPENSION OF ALL APPOINTMENTS OF SPECIAL AGENTS OF THE MILITARY
POLICE COMMAND, INCLUDING THOSE OF THE G-2 SERVICE OF THE MILITARY POLICE
COMMAND; OF ALL SPECIAL AGENTS OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR, CITY OR MUNICIPAL
MAYORS WITHIN THE PROVINCE OF CAVITE, AND THE CONFISCATION OF FIREARMS NOW IN
THEIR POSSESSION.
WHEREAS, there have been disturbances of peace and order in the City and Province of Cavite in which
special agents are reported to have been involved;
WHEREAS, it is necessary for the preservation of peace and order in the City and Province of Cavite that all
appointments of special agents be suspended;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, MANUEL ROXAS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in
me by law, do hereby order that:
1. All appointments of special agents of the MPC in the City and Province of Cavite, including those of the
G-2 Service of the MPC, and of special agents of the Provincial Governor and city or municipal mayors in the
Province of Cavite are hereby immediately suspended.
2. Any firearm now in the possession of such special agents should be duly surrendered to, or confiscated by,
the authorities concerned, as the case may be.
3. The Provincial Commander of the Province of Cavite is hereby directed to disarm all special agents
affected by this Order and to arrest those who may continue to exercise the functions thereof after this date.
4. Any intensive campaign should be waged for the arrest of any person carrying an unlicensed firearm found
within the jurisdiction of the City and Province of Cavite.
5. No government officer shall henceforth issue any firearm permit or license to any person without obtaining
the previous approval of the Office of the President.
